items.raw_excerpt: Christmas Village owners Jenny and Wayne Field are preparing for the opening night of their store this week.
items.summary_en: Jenny and Wayne Field run a Christmas Village shop in Taranaki, New Zealand. They are getting ready for opening night this week. The owners say this year will be twice as magical.

items.raw_excerpt: Entre montañas, formaciones minerales de colores intensos y antiguas historias, este destino mendocino combina naturaleza, paisajes y patrimonio.
items.summary_en: A small village in Mendoza sits among mountains. It has colorful mineral rock formations and hot springs. Visitors come for its nature and old heritage.

items.raw_excerpt: The Labrador retriever suffered a deep, open wound measuring 9cm long and 7cm deep after the scuffle with two Rottweilers and two Cane Corsos.
items.summary_en: A couple was fined after their four dogs escaped and hurt another dog. The hurt dog was a Labrador retriever being walked by a maid. The dog got a deep wound, 9cm long and 7cm deep.

items.summary_en: Mark Greenside, a New Yorker from California, is dragged by his girlfriend to a tiny Celtic village in Brittany at the western edge of France. He doubts he will ever really be French. This is a story about living in a small French village.

items.raw_excerpt: A new critical minerals bill aimed at stimulating investment has passed Queensland parliament, with amendments calming some farmers but other critics remain concerned.
items.summary_en: Queensland parliament passed a new critical minerals bill. The law aims to speed up mining investment. Some farmers still worry about its effects on their land.

items.raw_excerpt: One of the most picturesque sights in British Columbia is changing — as Mount Robson's Berg Glacier has retreated so far back that it no longer touches the water of Berg Lake.
items.summary_en: Mount Robson's Berg Glacier in British Columbia has retreated far back. The glacier no longer reaches the water of Berg Lake. This changes one of the most scenic views in the region.

items.title_en: Berg Glacier on Mount Robson No Longer Touches Berg Lake

items.raw_excerpt: Andhra Pradesh sustains kharif farming despite 51% rainfall deficit through strategic planning and increased crop insurance, says Minister Atchannaidu.
items.summary_en: Andhra Pradesh had a 51 percent rainfall shortfall this season. Farmers still kept kharif crops alive with good planning and more crop insurance. The state minister Atchannaidu said this shows careful preparation works.
items.summary_ko: 안드라프라데시는 이번 시즌 강수량이 51퍼센트나 부족했다. 그래도 계획을 잘 세우고 농작물 보험을 늘려 카리프 농사를 이어갔다. 아찬나이두 장관은 철저한 준비가 효과를 냈다고 말했다.
items.title_en: Andhra Pradesh farmers keep kharif crops alive despite low rain

items.raw_excerpt: Former actor-turned-hawker Huang Yiliang on why he agreed to act again after nearly 20 years, and why he won’t give up his crab bee hoon stall.
items.summary_en: Former actor Huang Yiliang is acting again after almost 20 years. He says it feels like a fish back in water. Still, he will not give up his crab bee hoon stall.

items.raw_excerpt: A heritage group wants to build a visitor centre in the garden of the star's childhood home in Bromley.
items.summary_en: A heritage group wants to build a visitor centre in the garden of David Bowie's childhood home in Bromley. Neighbours are against the plan. Their concerns may affect the group's building proposal.
